note: Toolbar and action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for file, edit, and view operations (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, Print, Help, Close, Apply, Cancel)
Toolbar and view toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for mode switches (e.g., Show Line Numbers, Show Right Margin, Fullscreen, Wrap Mode, Sidebar, Statusbar)
Preference and settings checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor configuration (e.g., Auto Indent, Insert Spaces, Highlight Syntax, Word Wrap, Show Cursor Position)
Preference and settings radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for exclusive configuration options (e.g., Tab Policy, Encoding, Line Ending, Font Family)
Status bar, preference, and section labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for field names and headings (e.g., Line, Column, Encoding, Language, Font, Size, Search, Replace, Results)
